name: All Saints Church

layers.essential_history: [[c:All Saints dates from the 12th century, and a wooden church may have stood here before it. Inside is a roll of honour and a memorial chapel for the men of the 351st Bomb Group.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Thomas de Thelwall, later Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster, was the parish priest here in the 1360s.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:In the porch you find a torn train ticket and a receipt.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The receipt]]
puzzle.question: [[c:How many shillings of change is missing?]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:Two shillings are missing from the change. Someone was in such a hurry they didn't wait for it.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:Someone bought a film tin in a hurry and left without their change.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head east, about 140 metres as the crow flies, to Polebrook Hall.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
